name: Chisha
source:
The older sister figure of the house. Takes care of the younger crowd when Michiru and Haina are busy. Also teaches math as a hobby (“Numbers speaks to her”). Cheerful, confident and a bit nosy most of the times, but spouts cryptic lines from time to time that puzzles Kai greatly…

[Edited and taken from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
